lines.text: By 6:30 PM Eastern Friday, shoppers had already spent $9.7 billion, Adobe says.

lines.text: That's up 12.8% from last year, ahead of Adobe's own forecast of 9.2%.

lines.text: So shoppers are spending faster than the trackers expected.

post.title: Black Friday online sales on track to top $13 billion
post.ig:
Black Friday online spending is on track to top $13 billion.
Shoppers spent $9.7B online by 6:30 PM ET Friday, up 12.8% from last year (Adobe).
Adobe had forecast $12.9B (+9.2%); it now projects $13.0B-$13.4B for the day. Final total not yet released.
Salesforce, which measures differently, projects $18.7B.
Next: Cyber Monday, forecast at $15.1B, up 6.2%.
Sources: Adobe Analytics, Reuters, Salesforce.
News and education, not financial advice.
